column3: Primary CTA — text-only with underline-on-hover, no chrome
column4: padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--em-fg); font-family: var(--em-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; padding-bottom: 2px; transition: opacity 200ms;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on fg ☐ visible focus-ring (offset outline) ☐ hover shifts opacity to 0.65 ☐ 44x44 effective tap area

column3: Tertiary action — mono eyebrow style
column4: padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--em-fg-muted); font-family: var(--em-mono); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border: none;
column5: ☐ uppercase + tracking applied ☐ AA contrast ☐ adequate touch area via padding-left

column3: Marketing hero — display serif headline + mono eyebrow + sub-deck
column4: max-width: 72ch; margin-inline: auto; padding-block: 120px 80px;
column5: ☐ headline serif loaded ☐ mono eyebrow visible above headline ☐ no hero-metric ☐ drop-cap optional on first paragraph

column3: Feature headline — serif display, balanced wrap
column4: font-family: var(--em-serif); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; color: var(--em-fg);
column5: ☐ text-wrap balance applied ☐ line-height tight (1.05-1.15) ☐ negative letter-spacing for display

column3: Section eyebrow — mono uppercase metadata above headlines
column4: display: block; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: var(--em-mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--em-fg-muted);
column5: ☐ adequate contrast vs ground ☐ tracking 0.08em ☐ accompanies headline (not standalone)

column3: Long-form body — serif, generous line-height, oldstyle nums
column4: font-family: var(--em-serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 65ch; font-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums; color: var(--em-fg);
column5: ☐ max 65ch enforced ☐ line-height 1.6-1.75 ☐ oldstyle numerals in prose ☐ AA contrast

column3: Pull-quote — display serif, no quote marks, hairline rule above
column4: margin-block: 48px; padding-block: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--em-rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--em-rule); font-family: var(--em-serif); font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic;
column5: ☐ semantic <blockquote> ☐ no quote-mark glyphs ☐ hairline rules top+bottom ☐ italic not bold

column3: Section divider — hairline rule, no box
column4: height: 1px; background: var(--em-rule); margin-block: 64px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ no box-shadow or gradient

column3: Drop-cap — first letter of feature story, 4-5× body size
column4: initial-letter: 3 2; margin-right: 8px; font-family: var(--em-serif); font-weight: 500; color: var(--em-accent);
column5: ☐ initial-letter supported (fallback to float+font-size) ☐ accent color used ☐ first paragraph only

column3: Article card — image-top, mono metadata, serif headline
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: none;
column5: ☐ semantic <article> ☐ image aspect-ratio locked ☐ mono eyebrow visible ☐ no card border or shadow

column3: Top nav — serif wordmark + mono links, hairline divider below
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 24px 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--em-rule); background: var(--em-ground);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link present ☐ baseline alignment for mixed typography

column3: Text input — bottom-rule only, serif typeface
column4: padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--em-fg); font-family: var(--em-serif); font-size: 1rem; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--em-rule); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ visible focus-ring on border-bottom-color shift ☐ font-size ≥16px (iOS) ☐ label above

column3: Editorial footer — serif columns, mono metadata, generous padding
column4: padding-block: 80px 48px; background: var(--em-ground); border-top: 1px solid var(--em-rule); font-family: var(--em-serif);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ multi-column responsive ☐ mono metadata rows beneath serif headings

column3: Image caption — mono, small, sits below image
column4: margin-top: 8px; font-family: var(--em-mono); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--em-fg-muted);

column3: Inline accent highlight — restrained warm tint
column4: background: var(--em-highlight); padding: 0 4px; color: var(--em-fg);
column5: ☐ no rounded-pill ☐ contrast AA on accent ground ☐ used sparingly (one per paragraph max)

column3: Section vertical rhythm — generous
column4: padding-block: clamp(80px, 12vh, 160px);
column5: ☐ section padding ≥80px ☐ clamp for responsive scaling

column3: Prose list — serif, hanging bullets, generous spacing
column4: font-family: var(--em-serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; padding-left: 1.5em;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<ol> ☐ marker color matches body fg ☐ items breathe vertically

column3: Editorial table — hairline rules, tabular nums
